title: Transistor patents traced to 1930s Germany

tellings.quote: know, the patents for the transistor were found go back to Germany in the 1930s.

plain: The patents for the transistor, the switch at the heart of all modern electronics, are said to go back to Germany in the 1930s. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about whether AI is alien technology. If true, it would mean the device's history starts earlier than the usual American story.
